[[Mushroom Kingdom (Super Mario Odyssey)|Mushroom Kingdom]] |next=[[Darker Side]] |directory=[[Super Mario Odyssey#Kingdoms|''Super Mario Odyssey'' kingdoms]] }} The '''Dark Side''' of the [[Moon]] is a secret kingdom in ''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]'', and is the greater location of '''Rabbit Ridge'''. It serves as the sixteenth kingdom overall in the game. It is reachable once the main game is completed and 250 [[Power Moon]]s have been obtained. Rabbit Ridge is the home of the [[Broodals]], and is ruled over by [[Madame Broode]]. Due to her love of vegetables, many statues of vegetables can be found scattered around the kingdom, primarily [[turnip]]s. The largest one, however, is a carrot building named [[Rabbit Ridge Tower]]. In Rabbit Ridge Tower, the Broodals challenge [[Mario]] to a rematch, and he is able to fight them as many times as he wants. If Mario loses all his health, he respawns outside of Rabbit Ridge Tower. None of the progress through the battles is saved if this occurs. Outside the tower, many generic [[rabbit]]s wearing top hats can be found; they can be neither spoken with nor [[capture]]d. No [[regional coin]]s exist in this kingdom, and as with the [[Moon Kingdom]] and [[Darker Side]], Mario experiences lighter [[gravity]]. This includes the interior of Rabbit Ridge Tower, but excludes the bonus areas. Once the player completes the sole objective of the Dark Side, [[Arrival at Rabbit Ridge!]], the [[Toad Brigade]] starts exploring this section of the Moon. ==Brochure details== {{SMO kingdom |subtitle=Remote Region, Even for the Moon |image=SMO Dark Brochure Art.png |area=Rabbit Ridge |area_subtitle=The last word in dedicated wedding planning. |population=Unknown |size=Unknown |locals=[[Rabbit]][[Broodals|ish?]] |currency=Unknown |industry=Wedding Planning |temperature=Unknown }} [[File:SMO Dark Brochure A.png|thumb|left|150px|''Sadly inedible tower & similarly inedible owner.'']] A Tasty-Looking Tower ''This ostentatious stone tower was carved at the direction of the vegetable-loving [[Madame Broode]], who lords over Rabbit Ridge.'' ''Her underlings, the Broodals, live within and always have a warm "welcome" for visitors.'' [[File:SMO Dark Brochure B.png|thumb|200px|''Poise under pressure.'']] Topper, Client Relations ''Responsible for client relations on behalf of the Broodals' wedding-planning firm, Topper is usually found on-site, troubleshooting.'' ''You can tell how serious he is about a battle by the number of hats he has stacked on his head: he doesn't tap into his full hat reserves except for the most dangerous opponents. So if you square off with him and he seems to be mostly hat, you should feel honored...and afraid.'' {{br}} [[File:SMO Dark Brochure D.png|thumb|left|150px|''Best hat-handler on the team.'']] Rango, the Bouncer ''He's not the most focused, but Rango is a valuable player on the Broodals team, always coming through in the end. A master of his boomeranging trampoline hat, he can throw it both straight and curved with almost unnatural control over the way it flies. On the other hand, he sometimes zones out a bit and looks confused. That's your chance to counterattack!'' [[File:SMO Dark Brochure E.png|thumb|150px|''It's best not to get her mad.'']] Hariet, Pyrotechnics ''The least predictable of the Broodals, Hariet is most often found throwing bombs with her hair. When her homemade bombs explode, they leave a pool of fire on the ground, so try knocking them away before they explode. While it may seem reckless to have filled her hat with bombs, Hariet is devious and keeps a lot of spare explosives with her, so watch out!'' [[File:SMO Dark Brochure F.png|thumb|left|150px|''Is the vulgarity all an act?'']] Spewart, the Entertainer ''Spinning around while spitting poison in a wide area, Spewart is the least subtle of the Broodals. But he also has an unexpectedly artistic side, as his poisonous ground-paintings show.'' {{br}} [[File:SMO Dark Brochure C.png|thumb|left|50px]] One Last Door ''For those travelers who survive the "hospitality" of the Broodals, [[RoboBrood|a new challenge may await]]...'' {{br}} [[File:SMO Dark Brochure G.png|thumb|350px]] Three Keys to the Kingdom # ''Watch out for the moon's light gravity; you can still die falling off a cliff.'' # ''Investigate behind all those stone-carved vegetables.'' # ''Greet all FOUR of the keys to this kingdom. You know who they are.'' {{br}} Map [[File:SMO Dark Brochure Map Update.png|thumb|left|200px]] {{br}} ==Sub-areas== {|class="wikitable" text-align="center" !Area !Entrance !Exit |- |align=center|[[File:RabbitRidgeTowerSMO.jpg|200px]]

The Magma Swamp |Moon Pipe |At the middle island's southmost end |An alternate version of the [[Luncheon Kingdom#The Magma Swamp|Magma Swamp]] in the [[Luncheon Kingdom]] where Mario must capture Yoshi and help him eat all the fruits to obtain both Power Moons. |} ==Enemies== Enemies marked with an asterisk (*) are only found in bonus areas. *[[Topper]] (boss) *[[Hariet]] (boss) *[[Spewart]] (boss) *[[Rango]] (boss) *[[RoboBrood]] (boss) *[[Hammer Bro]]s. *[[Bullet Bill]]s* *[[Bomber Bill|Banzai Bill]]s* *[[Poison Piranha Plant]]s* *[[Big Poison Piranha Plant]]s* *[[Sherm]]s* *[[Moonsnake]]s* *[[Fire Piranha Plant]]s* ==Objectives== #'''[[Arrival at Rabbit Ridge!]]''': The goal is to defeat the Broodals and RoboBrood on Rabbit Ridge Tower. ==Power Moons== [[File:SMO Power Moon Yellow.png|thumb|100px|The Dark Side has yellow Power Moons.]] {{main|List of Power Moons in the Dark Side}} There are a total of 26 [[Power Moon]]s (23 regular Power Moons and 1 [[Multi Moon]]) on the Dark Side. When the player first visits this kingdom, they can only collect 2 Power Moons, including the Multi Moon that is collected from defeating the Broodals for the last time. After they defeat them, 12 more Power Moons which are more difficult versions of previous challenges found throughout the other kingdoms will be unlocked as well as 10 pieces of [[Hint Art]]. The Dark Side has the most Hint Art out of any kingdom in the game. There are no [[Moon Rock]]s to break for Power Moons in this kingdom. ==Names in other languages== ===Dark Side=== {{foreign names |Jpn=月の国 裏 |JpnR=Tsuki no Kuni Ura |JpnM=Moon Country: Far Side |ChiS=月之国 后面 |ChiSR=Yuè zhī guó hòumiàn |ChiSM=Moon Country: The Back Side |ChiT=月之國 背面 |ChiTR=Yuè zhī guó bèimiàn |ChiTM=Moon Country: The Back Side |Dut=Schaduwkant |DutM=Shadow Side, this is the Dutch term for the moon's dark side. |Fre=Côté obscur |FreM=Dark Side |Ger=Finstere Seite |GerM=Dark Side |Ita=Lato Oscuro |ItaM=Dark Side |Kor=달나라 뒤편 |KorR=Dalnara Dwipyeon |KorM=Moon Country: The Back Side |Rus=Тёмная сторона |RusR=Tyomnaya storona |RusM=Dark Side |Spa=Cara Oculta |SpaM=Hidden Side }} ===Rabbit Ridge=== {{foreign names |Jpn=ラビットクレーター |JpnR=Rabitto Kurētā |JpnM=Rabbit Crater |ChiS=兔子环形山 |ChiSR=Tùzǐ huánxíngshān |ChiSM=Rabbit Crater |ChiT=兔子環形山 |ChiTR=Tùzǐ huánxíngshān |ChiTM=Rabbit Crater |Dut=Konĳnenkrater |DutM=Rabbit Crater |Fre=Crapinière |FreM=From ''crapule'' (scoundrel) and ''lapinière'' (rabbit hutch) |Ger=Kaninchenkrater |GerM=Rabbit Crater |Ita=Cresta Coniglia |ItaM=Rabbit Ridge |Kor=래빗 분화구 |KorR=Raebit Bunhwagu |KorM=Rabbit Crater |Rus=Кроличий хребет |RusR=Krolichiyi khrebet |RusM=Rabbit Ridge |Spa=Torre Madriguera |SpaM=Burrow Tower }} ==Notes== *The Dark Side, and the fact that the Broodals hail from the Moon, is likely a homage to the Japanese, folkloric belief that a [[wikipedia:Moon rabbit|rabbit lives on the moon]]. *Despite the fact that Madame Broode rules over the Rabbit Ridge, she is never seen here. *[[Rosalina]] makes a cameo appearance as an 8-bit sprite behind one of the statues outside Rabbit Ridge Tower. *Along with the [[Cap Kingdom]], this kingdom contains no 8-bit segments. {{Moons}} {{SMO}} {{SMO kingdoms}} [[de:Finsterer Seite]] [[it:Lato Oscuro]] [[Category:Secret levels]] [[Category:Cosmic areas]] [[Category:Super Mario Odyssey kingdoms]]
